title.title: Title
title.description: Alphanumeric, 600 characters - The name given to the work. Does not include any marketing adjectives outside of the given name. Example: Transformers: Dark of the Moon;Harry Potter;The Lion King
title.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

count.title: Total Count
count.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The total number of identical items in the package or box; a result of the multiplication of Multipack Quantity by Count Per Pack. Examples: (1) A single bottle of 50 pills has a "Total Count" of 50. (2) A package containing two identical bottles of 50 pills has a "Total Count" of 100. (3) A gift basket of 5 different items has a "Total Count" of 1. Example: 1;50;100
count.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

warrantyText.title: Warranty Text
warrantyText.description: Alphanumeric, 20000 characters - Warranty Text (the full text of the warranty terms, including what is covered by the warranty and the duration of the warranty). NOTE: please remember to update the text of your warranty as your warranty changes. Example: This warranty covers any defects in materials or workmanship, including installation, with the exceptions of fading or discoloration caused by exposure to sunlight or chemicals. This warranty runs for five years from the date your carpet is installed. Counterpoint will either replace your carpet with new carpet of similar composition and price, or refund the full purchase price of your carpet, whichever you prefer. Contact Counterpoint at 800-867-5309.

warrantyURL.title: Warranty URL
warrantyURL.description: URL, 2500 characters - The Warranty URL is the web location of the image, PDF, or link to the manufacturer's warranty page, showing the warranty and its terms, including the duration of the warranty. URLs must begin with http:// or https:// NOTE: Please remember to update the link and/or text of the warranty as the warranty changes. If supplying an image, provide the final destination image URL (no-redirects) that is publicly accessible (no username/password required) and ends in a proper image extension. Recommended file type: JPEG Accepted file types: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP Maximum file size: 5 MB. Example: http://www.walmart.com/warranty_info.pdf
warrantyURL.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

sku.title: SKU

productIdentifiers.title: Product Identifiers
productIdentifiers.description: Specify at least one Product ID and its ID Type.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Alphanumeric, 14 characters - Provide the GTIN that identifies the product's consumable (selling) unit. Expand the GTIN to 14 digits by adding preceding zeroes and check digit. A GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) is used to identify an item at any point in the Supply Chain. A GTIN refers to the data structure (not symbology) used to identify the scannable item, case, inner pack (i.e., break pack) or pallet that make up the hierarchy. Example: 00123456781011

productIdType.description:

UPC (Universal Product Code): 12-digit code.
EAN (European Article Number): 13-digit code.
GTIN (Global Trade Item Number): 14 digits code.
ISBN (International Standard Book Number): Code is used specifically for books (either 10 or 13 digits).

It's your obligation to research the all laws (Federal, State, Local) that impact your product and to indicate to Walmart the required state postal code sale restrictions. If the full state is restricted, please use the States attribute. Example: 94085, 94086, 94087, 72712, 72716

electronicsIndicator.description: Closed List - An item is considered electronic if it contains a circuit board or electrical wiring. This includes but is not limited to any item with a screen.

batteryTechnologyType.title: Product is or Contains this Battery Type
batteryTechnologyType.description: Closed List - Please select the Battery Technology Type from the list provided. 'Battery or battery containing product' is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise that is a battery or any component of merchandise, including reusable packaging intended to stay in use with the item, containing a battery of any chemistry/ type.

isChemical.title: Product is or contains a chemical
isChemical.description:
Closed List - ‘Chemical’ is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise that contains a powder, gel, paste or liquid that is not intended for human consumption, including any item that is regulated for transportation as a hazardous material pursuant to the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) or as a dangerous good by any international regulatory body.   

Notwithstanding the foregoing, ‘Chemical’ also includes the following item types that are intended for human consumption, inhalation, or absorption, or labeled with ‘Drug Facts’ or ‘Supplement Facts’:  

All over-the-counter medications, including: lozenges, pills, or capsules (e.g. pain relievers; vitamins and supplements).
Medicated swabs, wipes, bandages, acne medication, and sunscreen.
Medicated patches (such as nicotine patches).
Liquids (e.g. cough medicine, eye/ear drops, nasal spray, and inhalers).
Medicated shampoos, gums, ointments, and creams.
Lip balm, lip creams and petroleum jelly. 
Contraceptive foam, films, and spermicides; 
Product/equipment sold with chemicals (e.g. vaporizer sold with medication); and Electronic cigarettes.

isAerosol.title: Product is or contains an aerosol
isAerosol.description: Closed List - Aerosol is any item that contains a compressed gas or propellant (including bag-on-valve and other pressurized designs).

isPesticide.title: Product is a pesticide (Includes pesticide devices and antimicrobial treated products)
isPesticide.description:
Closed List - Pesticide is any item that is advertised or claims to prevent, destroy, repel or mitigate any pest (e.g., weed, insect, rodent, anti-microbial, anti-bacterial, anti-fungal).

Even if the item is not a chemical, it may be considered a pesticide if it makes any claims of protection from pathogens or microorganisms that extend beyond the item itself.

Examples of such claims: antibacterial, bactericidal, germicidal, germ-resistant, bacteria-resistant, kills pathogenic bacteria.

safetyDataSheet.title: Safety Data Sheet
safetyDataSheet.description:
URL, 2500 characters - A Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or equivalent data documentation is used to provide Walmart Inc. with accurate product information to aid in compliance with State and federal storage, handling, shipment, and disposal regulations. An item that is or contains a lithium or lead acid battery type, requires a battery detail document which may be referred to as something other than a SDS. Examples include:  Lab Test Report, Article Information Sheet, Product Datasheet, or Battery Specification document.  

If your item has multiple chemical and/or battery components, submit 1 link with all SDS/battery documents combined into continuation pages.

Some product types, such as OTC medications and supplements do not require an SDS. You can use a label image of the ingredients, drug facts, supplement facts or warnings panels for these product types.
safetyDataSheet.comments: @group=Conditional/Required for Hazardous Materials (Only Complete Relevant Hazmat Attributes)

ionNumberOfBatteries.title: Battery Count
ionNumberOfBatteries.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 9999999 - The total number of batteries in the package. Example: 1; 2; 3; 4 Example: 1; 2; 3; 4

ionNumberOfBatteryCells.title: Battery Cell Count
ionNumberOfBatteryCells.description:
Number, Value range: 0 to 999 - The total number of cells (per the definitions for "Cell" and "Button cell" below) included in the package.   

Battery: A unit consisting of two or more cells linked together and typically having a single set of positive and negative terminals.
Cell: An individual cylindrical shaped power unit commonly referred to as a battery.
Button cell (a.k.a. coin cell battery): Small single cell battery shaped like a button or coin.

ionBatteryFormFactor.title: Battery Form Factor
ionBatteryFormFactor.description:
Closed List - Choose one of these types:

Battery: A unit consisting of two or more cells linked together and typically having a single set of positive and negative terminals.
Cell: An individual cylindrical shaped power unit commonly referred to as a battery.
Button cell (a.k.a. coin cell battery): Small single cell battery shaped like a button or coin.

ionBatteryModel.title: Battery Model
ionBatteryModel.description: Alphanumeric, 400 characters - The model name and number (e.g. Canon LP-E17) for each battery component. Example: Cannon LP-E17

ionIncludedBatteryPackaging.title: Included Battery Packaging
ionIncludedBatteryPackaging.description:
Closed List - Describes how the battery is packed with the item. 

Loose: An item that's being sold as a standalone battery.
Contained in: Batteries are installed in your item before shipment.
Packed with: Batteries come with your item, but aren't installed in the item.

batteryWattHour.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - Watt hour is the energy capacity rating required for lithium-ion batteries. This can be found on the battery, in the battery details document such as the lab test report, or possibly on the manufacturer's website.

ionBatteryWeight.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - The total weight in grams of one lithium battery in the package.  Example: 5;6;7;8

metalIncludedBatteryPackaging.description: Closed List - Identifies how the battery is packaged to determine if a hazmat label is required on the outer shipping box, when shipped from our facilities. "Loose" - A package of batteries only. "Contained in" - Product is sold with the battery installed in the product and there are no non-installed batteries in the package. metalNumberOfBatteries.title: Battery Count

(Ex. power tool 18V battery pack) "Cell"= individual cylindrical shaped power unit commonly referred to as a battery (such as a Panasonic NCR18650B) used to power a device. "Button Cell" (a.k.a. coin cell battery, ex: CR2330): A small single cell battery shaped like a button or coin used to power a device.

items.title: Required Storage Condition
items.description: Closed List - Identifies and communicates the temperature storage condition required to maintain item safety, quality and/or efficacy.

pesticide_type.title: Pesticide Type
pesticide_type.description:
Closed List - Regulatory category that identifies how a pesticide related product is classified under applicable regulations.

EPA Registered Pesticide: A pesticide product reviewed and approved by the EPA for sale and use in the U.S. These products must show an EPA registration number and EPA establishment number on the label.



Minimum Risk Pesticide 25(b): A pesticide product that meets EPA’s minimum risk criteria and is exempt from federal registration. Product can only contain EPA approved ingredients that pose little or no risk to human health or the environment and follow EPA labeling requirements.



Pesticide Device: A physical or mechanical tool designed to control pests (such as traps or UV light systems). Devices must display an EPA establishment number on the label.



Treated Article: An item treated with an EPA approved antimicrobial chemical to protect the item itself from microbes such as mold, mildew or bacteria. Claims must focus only on protecting the product, not people.
pesticide_type.comments: @group=Conditional/Required for Hazardous Materials (Only Complete Relevant Hazmat Attributes)

IsPreorder.title: Is Preorder

releaseDate.title: Release Date
releaseDate.description: Date, Provide the date that the item will be released to the public by the manufacturer. Release Date is REQUIRED for setting up an item as a preorder.  Example: yyyy-mm-dd Example: 2016-01-20

startDate.title: Site Start Date
startDate.description: DateTime, Indicates the date and time (UTC) when the item will be published on site. For preorders, this will be the date and time when the item can be Preordered by a customer. Enter hours based on military time (24-hour window, e.g. For 8PM, it will be 20 in hours) Example: yyyy-mm-dd  hh : mm : ss

endDate.title: Site End Date
endDate.description: Date, Indicates the date when the partner's item should be removed from the site. Example: yyyy-mm-dd

MustShipAlone.title: Must ship alone?
MustShipAlone.description: Closed List - Select "Yes" if your item cannot ship with another item in the same box. If marked "Yes," the ship alone item will not be grouped for ship price calculation.

shipsInOriginalPackaging.title: Ships in Original Packaging
shipsInOriginalPackaging.description: Closed List - Can this product be shipped in the original packaging without being put in an outer box? Notes: 1) This is to indicate whether it's *possible* for the item to be shipped in original box, not whether it is required. 2) This was previously known as"Ships As-Is."

SkuUpdate.title: SKU Update
SkuUpdate.description: Closed List - Selecting "Yes" allows the replacement of a previously submitted SKU associated with a standardized unique identifier (i.e. GTIN, ISBN, UPC, EAN) without generating an error. If "Yes" is not selected, the system will not permit the uploading of two SKUs with the same standardized unique identifier. NOTE: You should only select "Yes" if you are deliberately replacing a SKU. Selecting "Yes" in other circumstances may lead to data loss.

externalProductIdentifier.title: External Product Identifier
externalProductIdentifier.description: Closed List - Optional. Specify External Product Identifier and its ID Type if available.

items.title: External Product Identifier
items.description: Closed List - Optional. Specify External Product Identifier and its ID Type if available.

externalProductIdType.title: External Product ID Type
externalProductIdType.description: Closed List - Specifies the type of external marketplace product identifier associated with the item, such as Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) or Mercado Libre ID (MLID).

externalProductId.title: External Product ID
externalProductId.description: Alphanumeric, 20 characters - The Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) or Mercado Libre ID (MLID) associated with the item, based on the selected External Product ID Type. Example: B002Z36VJE

thirdPartyProductFulfillmentType.title: Third Party Product Fulfillment Type
thirdPartyProductFulfillmentType.description:
Closed List - The type of fulfillment method(s) that a third party supplier(3P) states can be used to deliver products to consumers.
Used by third party(3P) suppliers to tell the buyer and downstream fulfillment systems what methods of fulfillment can be used to deliver products to consumers.

items.title: Third Party Product Fulfillment Type
items.description:
Closed List - The type of fulfillment method(s) that a third party supplier(3P) states can be used to deliver products to consumers.
Used by third party(3P) suppliers to tell the buyer and downstream fulfillment systems what methods of fulfillment can be used to deliver products to consumers.

msrp.title: MSRP
msrp.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999 - Manufacturer's suggested retail price. This is not the price that Walmart customers will pay for your product. You can use up to 8 digits before the decimal place. Do not use commas or dollar signs. Example: 19.95

minimumSellerAllowedPrice.title: Minimum Seller Allowed Price
minimumSellerAllowedPrice.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - Your offer's floor/lowest price at which you are willing to sell it for. You must set a valid minimum seller allowed price for repricer to take action. Note: The Repricer will not overwrite existing MAP price rules applied through the Price & Promotions Spec. Example: 23.99

maximumSellerAllowedPrice.title: Maximum Seller Allowed Price
maximumSellerAllowedPrice.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - Your offer's ceiling/highest price at which you are willing to sell it for. You must set a valid maximum seller allowed price for repricer to take action. Example: 49.99

repricerStrategy.title: Repricer Strategy
repricerStrategy.description: Alphanumeric, 75 characters - Prepopulated list of exisiting repricer strategies name that a seller has setup. The Repricing strategy that you wish to assign to your items. Select from the drop-down or copy and paste the Strategy Name from the Repricer page in Seller Center. This field is case and space sensitive - please ensure that the name matches exactly as it appears on the Repricer page. Select "No Strategy/Delete from Repricer" to remove your items from a currently mapped strategy.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: Alphanumeric, 50 characters - The letters and/or numbers a partner uses to identify an item. Walmart includes this value in all communications regarding item information such as orders. Example: TRVAL28726

countryOfOriginAssembly.title: Country of Origin
countryOfOriginAssembly.description: Closed List - The country where the item and/or its components are manufactured, produced, or grown.

items.title: Country of Origin
items.description: Closed List - The country where the item and/or its components are manufactured, produced, or grown.

each.title: Each
each.description: This is an object that contains child attributes in Akodo
each.comments: @group=Required for Walmart's supply chain (only complete relevant Trade Items)

eachDepth.title: Depth (in)
eachDepth.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - If the Trade Item is the consumable (sellable) unit: Depth is the longest horizontal measurement, front to back, with the product sitting on its natural base and facing forward. If the Trade Item is not the consumable (sellable) unit: Depth is the longest horizontal measurement, with the product sitting on its natural base. Example: 10

eachWeight.title: Weight (lbs)
eachWeight.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999 - The weight of the Trade Item at Each level, including all of its packaging materials. Example: 5

eachWidth.title: Width (in)
eachWidth.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - If the Trade Item is the consumable (sellable) unit: Width is shortest horizontal measurement, left to right, with the product sitting on its natural base and facing forward. If the Trade Item is not the consumable (sellable) unit: Width is the shortest horizontal measurement, with the product sitting on its natural base. Example: 80

eachHeight.title: Height (in)
eachHeight.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - If the Trade Item is the consumable (sellable) unit: Height is the vertical measurement, top to bottom, with the product sitting on its natural base and facing forward. If the Trade Item is not the consumable (sellable) unit: Height is the  vertical measurement, top to bottom, with the product sitting on its natural base. Example: 40
